title: The forest moves.
note: Locked maze v4 with two middle-wall pieces left out ([14, 8], [15, 10]): the route takes that shortcut (54 cells) until Sow a Ridge seals it at 6 s and the route snaps back to the whole serpentine (70). On an open board a ridge is easy to walk around now that nightmares fit half-cell gaps, so the ridge has to close a real shortcut. Act break = drift 26.
captions: After every boss, the Heartwood gives you a gift.
This one raises a ridge of dead trees.
The route bends around it. The long way now.
A new map every run, and you get to change it.
